objective: Enforce evidence-first root-cause improvements and limit cross-feature regressions in all new BUKLOD workstreams without changing product runtime
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main SHA 646617b500215b27356c55519c548f140e554a21 inspected on 2026-10-30; installed phone and actual production OTA have not been reverified. This policy change must not trigger production publication.
chosenApproach: Extend existing AGENTS.md and single Engineering Accountability PR workflow with a no-dependency impact gate and self-tests
alternativeApproaches: Add a separate large CI workflow with full native builds on each PR (rejected: runner credits and regressions from redundant pipelines)
Rely on agent instructions and source text checks alone (rejected: cannot catch behavior omissions)
Extend existing lightweight PR workflow with scope/impact checks and targeted runnable tests (selected)
selectionRationale: Retains the existing PR gate and zero production runtime changes; introduces repeatable fail-closed coverage checks with low runner cost.
preserveBehaviors: No changes to Wall, Connect, Cluster, Show Faith, Classroom, Quiz or Auth product code
No build/production Android OTA, new APK, Supabase migration, or user data mutation
Existing branch-specific quality tests and the canonical release workflow remain in place
Never confuse static assertions or test-file presence with proven runtime and on-device behavior
acceptanceChecks: New and changed scope manifests explicitly capture alternatives, chosen rationale, preserved behaviors, impact areas and tests
Every product change in a PR has a changed focused regression test; multiple impacted areas need corresponding tests
Supabase changes require SQL tests; production identity/release changes require focused Node release tests
The guard runs its own behavioral tests and runs changed Node tests on PRs; fails closed on unavailable baseline
Existing accountability gate passes for exact branch baseline and paths
No automatic Actions run unless a PR is opened; no production OTA is triggered by these changed paths
